leak.history_comparison: 11-18 -11.15 / 11-19 -11.36 / 11-20 -11.64 / 11-21 -11.13 / 11-22 -9.25 / 11-23 -11.27 / 11-24 -11.14 / today -17.63. The 4-second buckets show why: from 44 s on the trace develops a regular sawtooth of +1.5..+1.9 mmHg upward steps every ~1.3 s, so a least-squares slope over the window is dominated by how many steps land inside it.
